I replied to Hollis in the #inc-tansley-carrier-api thread: the Marrow Agrisupply store is **Pine Crossing**.

The source is #central-team, a channel Hollis is in. On June 9, Priyanka said the morning receiver at Pine Crossing could only see the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. She added that a driver arrived at 7:10 the day before and they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note.
